text: A small six-week trial of 48 older adults found daily walks lowered blood pressure about 3 points, in non-medicated people.
Coffee's memory boost was only tested in mice, using a dose equal to eight cups daily.
One Chinese call-centre firm found home-working volunteers gained 13 percent productivity, mostly from fewer breaks.
The new bridge saves northside drivers about four minutes on average, measured during school holidays.
Pooled 25 mixed-quality trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds, only in deficient people; about one fewer cold per 30 yearly.
A four-week test of a reading app improved letter recognition but not story comprehension, in children who already had tutors.
In lab bee colonies, a pesticide at ten times field doses shortened foraging trips but didn't kill colonies.
A four-day week trial among volunteer firms with no comparison group cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
